content.comment_body: Has anyone got a sample setup for measuring temperature using [product_name] and an LM35 sensor? Thanks!
Which temperature range do you need to process?

I'm using an LM35DZ sensor, which covers a temperature range from 0 °C to 100 °C. I read the value using an analog input (0-10V). For each 1 °C change, the LM35DZ output shifts by 10 mV (0.01 V). Here are the analog input parameters: Sensor: 0-10V Min: 0 Max: 1000 Gain: 1.00 Offset: 0 These settings allow measurement in a range of 0 - 1000 °C, while the sensor itself outputs 0.00 to 1.00 V, corresponding to 0 - 100 °C.
Thanks, I will give that a try.
